name: Canvas
instructions: A shared drawing page. Diagrams live in this plugin's local database. Agents use canvas_read / canvas_edit or kg canvas show. Send pastes a short pointer into a chosen thread in the current project without submitting it (host.pasteIntoThread, or kg thread paste). The thread list uses the threads area. Clipboard read is for paste of copied shapes. Copy as image stays off: the clipboard call only accepts text.

tools.name: canvas_read
tools.description: Read a shared drawing canvas as one line per element. Without a name, lists the canvases.

tools.name: canvas_edit
tools.description: Draw on a shared canvas by applying a list of ops. Returns new ids and the lines that changed. The canvas must already exist.
